title: 3 free tools se AI agent banao
content:
Is weekend aap apna pehla AI agent bana sakte ho.
And you don't need to pay for a single tool.
Sirf teen FREE tools. Let's go.

Pehle samjho agent hota kya hai.
Chatbot sirf jawab deta hai.
An agent takes a goal, plans the steps, and uses tools to finish the job.
Jaise... email padhna, sheet update karna, ya report banana.
Aur ye sab banane ke liye aapko bada budget nahi chahiye.

Tool number ONE... Ollama.
Ollama aapke laptop pe open models chalata hai.
It is open source, MIT licensed, and the GitHub repo has over one hundred eighty thousand stars.
Matlab aapka data aapki machine pe rehta hai.
Testing ke time pe koi API bill nahi.
Ek command... aur model ready.

Par sirf model se agent nahi banta.
Asli twist yahan hai... agent ko steps ka ek clear flow chahiye.

Tool number TWO... LangGraph.
LangGraph se aap agent ke steps ek graph ki tarah design karte ho.
Step one, plan. Step two, tool call. Step three, check the result.
If something fails, the agent can retry or ask a human.
Ye bhi MIT licensed hai, aur Python mein kaafi seedha hai.

Tool number THREE... Langfuse.
Ye sabse UNDERRATED hai.
Langfuse dikhata hai ki agent ne andar kya kiya.
Every prompt, every tool call, every answer... sab trace hota hai.
Jab agent galat jawab de, toh aapko pata hoga KYUN.
Aur aap ise khud host kar sakte ho.

Ab weekend plan suno.
Saturday subah... Ollama install karo aur ek chhota model chalao.
Saturday shaam... LangGraph mein teen step ka agent banao.
Sunday... Langfuse jodo aur dekho agent kahan atak raha hai.
Maan lo aapka agent har subah aapke inbox ke important emails ki list banata hai.
That is a small project, but it is a REAL one.

Builder tip.
Pehle ek boring task choose karo jo aap har hafte karte ho.
Don't start with a fancy demo.
Chhota agent jo sach mein kaam kare, wahi portfolio mein chamakta hai.
Aur jab ye chal jaye, toh ek naya tool jodo... ek ek karke.

Comment AGENT and I'll DM you all three links.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
